Example activation data

Source: R/data.R
am.Rd

Simulated TURF activation data for 15,000 respondents and 53 products. A cell is 1 if the respondent is activated by (would choose) that product, and 0 otherwise.

Usage

am

Format

A tibble with 15,000 rows (respondents) and 53 columns (products, northwind through york). Every column is an integer vector of 0s and 1s.

Source

Simulated by data-raw/DATASET.R in the package source, which regenerates it exactly.

Details

Respondents come from five simulated segments of 5,000, 4,000, 3,000, 2,000, and 1,000 respondents, each with its own activation rate per product, plus some random noise. Overall rates range from about 4% to 14% per product. Every respondent activates on between one and five products; about 98% on exactly five. Product names are arbitrary placeholders.

Examples

dim(am)
#> [1] 15000    53

# Share of respondents activated by each product
head(sort(colMeans(am), decreasing = TRUE))
#> southwind       coi     lemon       may     green       red 
#> 0.1404000 0.1352667 0.1351333 0.1341333 0.1318000 0.1277333
